title: CompositionPolicy
description: Reusable graph-composition rule. Never keyed by family. Matched by authored-intent precondition. Loaded from std/procedural/knowledge/policy/*.json.

domain.description: Domain this policy targets. Must match a registered DomainExtensionManifest.domain_id.

precondition.description: When this policy applies. Pure-data predicate over authored intent. No family-name checks.

requires_node_types.description: Graph must contain at least one node of each listed NODE_TYPE.

forbids_node_types.description: Graph must NOT contain any node of these NODE_TYPEs.

requires_brief_fields.description: Brief must have these exact field=value pairs.

requires_parts_any.description: Asset parts list must contain at least one of these names.

forbids_parts_any.description: Asset parts list must contain none of these names.

requires_intent_tags.description: Asset.intent must list all these tags.

expansions.description: Ordered list of structural additions this policy makes when its precondition matches. Each expansion adds a NODE_TYPE (never a family name).

add_node_type.description: NODE_TYPE to add. Must be registered in some DomainExtensionManifest.

count.description: Number of nodes of this type to add. May resolve from a brief field.

placement.description: Pure-data placement rule consumed by the generator.

attributes_template.description: Default attributes for the added node(s).

edges_to_existing.description: Edges this expansion creates to pre-existing nodes.
